# Lantern Hymn
key: F, time: 3/4

## Verse
| [1/4] C | F | Bb / F | C |
lyrics 1: | The | lamp / is | lit / a- | gain |
lyrics 2: | The | night / is | long / and | still |
| F | Bb | C7 | F |
lyrics 1: | and / we | sing / to | keep / it | warm |
lyrics 2: | and / the | stars / are | on / the | hill |
